notes: Extracted SafelistTagAttributes class and moved tag/attribute state and operations into it. Updated Safelist to use an encapsulated SafelistTagAttributes instance and adjusted constructors, factory methods, and attribute/protocol handling. Updated tests in org.jsoup.safety to call safelist.tagAttributes.add*/remove* where they previously invoked those methods on Safelist. Preserved public behavior and delegated isSafeTag through Safelist to maintain compatibility for subclasses in other packages.
